description: Drops an extension from one database. Never cascades: while a table, index or function uses it, Postgres refuses and the reason comes back. Code that calls its functions stops working.

confirm_name.description: The exact instance name, as a guard against acting on the wrong one. Call get_instance first and copy it from there.

id.description: Instance id, as returned by list_instances

name: remove_extension
title: Remove a PostgreSQL extension
